unit: Exported payload record; not established executed tool call
source_deduplication: Two downloads have identical bytes; analyze one logical source

analysis.url: Existing canonical_url on complete unredacted spans only; never keep a prefix truncated at a redaction
analysis.alias_identity: Exact case-sensitive spelling, including leading zeros, scoped to source SHA; equality does not guarantee unique original URLs
analysis.paths: Quoted literal paths accepted by existing path primitives; root-record scoped references only, no cross-record shared-file or operation claim
analysis.duplicate_sensitivity: Exact whole-payload byte hash only for duplicate-accounting sensitivity; no fuzzy or passage matching
analysis.responses: Generic reference sets on kind=response; compare only to explicitly named payload parent, without success or time interpretation
analysis.recovered_text: Excluded from content analysis to avoid recovered/derived views and double counting

gated_metrics.reason: Metadata does not establish executed calls, chronology, runs, actors or immutable producer/use relations. These quantities are unavailable, not zero.

inspection_before_freeze: All outer metadata; text/tags/cite excluded from initial inventory
Payload complete-JSON field names/types, not field values
First six payload text prefixes to identify literal JS request expressions and redaction syntax; no signal curves
Independent metadata graph/citation audit; no source URLs followed
